    prev = [-1] * n

    for i in range(1, n):
        for j in range(i):
            if abs(people[i][0] - people[j][0]) <= 1:
                if dp[i] < dp[j] + 1:

            max_length = dp[i]

        circle.append(current)
        current = prev[current]
        if current == end_index:
            break
